## Packaged resources

```{r download, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Read the installed package version for the archive name.
resources_version <- as.character(utils::packageVersion("ros.db.atlas"))
# Show a download link when building the package website.
if (identical(Sys.getenv("IN_PKGDOWN"), "true")) {
  cat(sprintf("[Download package resources (%s, ZIP)](../ros.db.atlas-resources-%s.zip).\n\n",
    resources_version, resources_version))
}
# Describe the installed resources included in the archive.
resources <- data.frame(
  File = c(
    "config/ros-db.example.yaml", "config/ros-code-list-urls.csv",
    "templates/atlas-report.Rmd.tpl", "templates/atlas-report.css", "templates/IOTC_with_text.png"
  ),
  Purpose = c(
    "PostgreSQL connection template with a session password reference.",
    "URLs for the official IOTC reference tables.",
    "IOTC HTML report template.",
    "Report stylesheet.",
    "IOTC logo used in reports."
  )
)
# Link the raw files on the website, preserving their extensions.
if (identical(Sys.getenv("IN_PKGDOWN"), "true")) {
  resources$File <- sprintf(
    "[`%s`](https://ultreia-io.github.io/ros.db.atlas/%s)", resources$File, resources$File
  )
} else {
  resources$File <- sprintf("`%s`", resources$File)
}
# Display the resource inventory.
knitr::kable(resources, format = "pipe")
```

## Editable ROS metadata

The tracked snapshot lives under `models/4.0.0/` in the repository.

The schema, table, and column CSVs carry the descriptions. The key CSVs and `dependencies.csv` describe relationships.

Use [Getting started](atlas.html) to update the snapshot and [ROS reports](reports.html) to render it.
